scope: Diagnostics for additional directions; no new production optimization. Accepted position-reuse direction remains closed.
nesting: geometry_before_tick includes geometry_advance_turrets and fleet pose work; geometry_advance_turrets includes enemy read-model publication. Do not treat its 3.779ms as independent turret work. launch/drone_launch include their fleet screen muzzle calls.
fleet_decision: Do not implement: configure .009ms, pose_base .051ms, set_slot_angles .065ms, screen muzzle queries .161ms combined. No >1ms potential for this separate fleet-transform direction.
render_decision: Root canvas about 754 draws / 2.74ms CPU, ship 386 visible draws / .79ms CPU and 2.66ms GPU. These are whole-stage costs, not removable overhead. Existing native flight painter already batches ordered triangle streams; static enemy parts already retain Canvas commands. No demonstrated quality-preserving >1ms elimination was found.
layer_diagnostic_limits: Frozen-frame visibility isolation only, never an accepted optimization or equal-work benchmark. Foreground accounts for about 302 canvas draws but its isolated CPU reduction was only .35ms. Equipment hiding caused layout/visibility side effects and that CPU result is invalid for cost attribution. Do not sum isolation deltas. All production visibility and quality remain unchanged.
unresolved: High-load <10ms target remains unmet. A further optimization needs an identifiable removable >1ms dataflow or draw submission cost; current totals alone are insufficient. No more microtuning or failed-direction repeats.
